variants.name: 6XC
variants.info:
Load your FT300 with the 6XC wildcat cartridge.
Offering poorer close range performance to the .243 winchester cartridge, but it is preferred for long range usage with its slightly improved velocity and ranges due to weight and a faster reload and action time. Small increase to penetration.

variants.name: .308 Win.
variants.info:
Load your FT300 with the .308 Winchester cartridge.
A heavier cartridge than .243 Winchester with a slightly lower velocity. More power with improved performance in long range, good if you want something between power for close range engagements and velocity for longer range engagements.

variants.name: .22 LR
variants.info:
Load your FT300 with the .22 Long Rifle cartridge.
This ammo type deals poorer damage in long range to the body and limbs, but still competes due to a fast reload and surprisingly high torso damage. Does not pair with the Marksman Kit and will always single load ammunition. No reserve ammo.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 7.5x55mm
variants.info:
Load your FT300 with the 7.5x55mm Swiss cartridge.
A heavier cartridge doing greater damage across range to an enemies torso, but travels slower with a slower reload. Higher penetration.
